queries.contradictoryStates:
select id, confirmation_no, phase, station_seq, station_status from public.jobs
          where (phase in ('done', 'cancelled') and (station_seq is not null or station_status is not null))
             or (phase = 'production' and (station_seq is null or station_status is null))
queries.orphanedMachineAssignments:
select ma.id, ma.job_id, j.confirmation_no, j.phase, j.station_seq, j.station_status
          from public.machine_assignments ma join public.jobs j on j.id = ma.job_id
          where ma.released_at is null and (j.phase in ('done', 'cancelled') or j.station_status = 'out')
queries.orphanedOpenIssues:
select i.id, i.job_id, j.confirmation_no, j.phase from public.issues i join public.jobs j on j.id = i.job_id
          where i.closed_at is null and j.phase in ('done', 'cancelled')
queries.orphanedOutRuns:
select r.id, r.job_id, j.confirmation_no, j.phase from public.outsource_runs r join public.jobs j on j.id = r.job_id
          where r.closed_at is null and j.phase in ('done', 'cancelled')
queries.splitQtySumCheck: select sum(qty)::int as family_sum from public.jobs where confirmation_no like 'SC-D2-SP%'
queries.pendingChecksOnClosedJobs:
select c.id, c.job_id, j.confirmation_no, j.phase from public.station_checks c join public.jobs j on j.id = c.job_id
          where c.status = 'pending' and j.phase in ('done', 'cancelled')
